hints.title: Suffix Stream Recognition
hints.text: A match occurs whenever a sequence of recent characters forms a dictionary word ending at the current query.

hints.title: Reverse Trie Matching
hints.text: Insert all words reversed into a prefix tree. Upon receiving each query letter, traverse the tree backwards through stream history.

hints.title: Stream History Blueprint
hints.text: Store query stream in a ring buffer or list. For each query, walk nodes from root backwards; if a terminal word node is met, return true.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Reverse prefix tree bounds each query walk by the depth of the longest dictionary word.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Forward trie matching requires maintaining multiple active pointers that branch exponentially with duplicate prefixes.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing words reversed transforms arbitrary suffix search into deterministic root-to-leaf prefix descent.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Reverse prefix tree design and stream history truncation to max word length.

solutions.approach: Reverse Prefix Tree with Bounded History
